candidates.title: APR Calculator

boundedContract.profile: Regular US closed-end single advance, two or more equal monthly end-period payments; already determined AF, or bounded simple unsecured loan fee construction
boundedContract.formula: B0=AF; Bk=B(k-1)*(1+i)-P; solve Bn=0, equivalently AF=sum(P/(1+i)^k,k=1..n); APR percent=1200*i. Optional simple loan AF=principal+other financed non-finance-charge amounts-prepaid finance charges, avoiding double counting.
boundedContract.units: USD; i decimal/month; APR percentage points/year
boundedContract.domain: AF>0,P>0,n integer>=2; AF<=n*P for nonnegative rate; no odd periods, irregular payments, further advances, add-on/discount charges, mortgage/insurance/excluded fee classification. Monthly dates obey Appendix J b(3)(iv); first due one full month after finance charge begins. AF supplied legally classified; optional only creditor-imposed loan fee with no 1026.4 exclusion and no cash-comparable fee.
boundedContract.validation: Reject missing AF classification, schedule mismatches, nonfinite/negative amounts, n<2 or AF>nP; no default fee classification. Strictly decreasing PV ensures unique nonnegative root; AF=nP gives zero.
boundedContract.rounding: Carry sufficient precision to prove correct nearest 0.01 percentage-point APR by enclosing root until both interval endpoints round identically. Reject exact halfway or unresolved enclosure; tie mode is separate product policy. Mathematical recurrence derived from textual a(2), not unviewed raster equation.
